title: Backend Developer
description:
**Backend Developer**

**Experience:** 6 Months – 2 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Job Type:** Backend Development / Software Development

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **Backend Developer** with 6 months to 2 years of experience in developing and maintaining backend applications. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience working with **ERP, CRM, HRM, or similar business management applications** and a good understanding of databases, APIs, and cloud technologies.

The candidate will be responsible for developing backend features, creating and integrating APIs, managing databases, troubleshooting issues, and supporting application deployment and maintenance.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance backend applications and services.
* Work on business applications such as **ERP, CRM, HRM, and related enterprise systems**.
* Develop and integrate **RESTful APIs**.
* Implement business logic, validations, authentication, and authorization.
* Design and maintain database tables, relationships, queries, and stored procedures.
* Integrate backend services with frontend applications and third\-party APIs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application and database issues.
* Optimize backend performance and database queries.
* Work with Git/GitHub for version control.
* Support application deployment and production maintenance.
* Assist with cloud\-based application deployment and configuration.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, and other team members.
* Maintain technical documentation and follow coding standards.

**Required Skills**

* **6 months to 2 years of hands\-on backend development experience.**
* Experience working with **ERP, CRM, HRM, or enterprise applications**.
* Good knowledge of at least one backend technology:
* **Python / Django / Flask / FastAPI**
* **Java / Spring Boot**
* **Node.js / Express.js**
* Strong understanding of **REST APIs, HTTP methods, JSON, and API integration**.
* Good knowledge of **SQL and relational databases** such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Understanding of database design, relationships, queries, and optimization.
* Knowledge of **Git and GitHub**.
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills.

**Cloud \& Deployment Knowledge**

Candidates should have a basic to intermediate understanding of cloud technologies, preferably:

* **AWS**
* EC2
* S3
* RDS
* IAM
* Basic deployment concepts
* **Microsoft Azure**
* Azure App Service
* Azure Storage
* Azure Database
* Basic deployment and configuration

Knowledge of **Docker, CI/CD, Linux, and cloud deployment** will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **ERP/CRM/HRM workflows**.
* Knowledge of authentication methods such as **JWT/OAuth**.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs.
* Knowledge of **Docker and containerization**.
* Basic knowledge of **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Familiarity with Linux servers.
* Understanding of application security and data validation.
* Experience with production deployment and troubleshooting.

**Education**

* BCA / MCA / B.Tech / BE / B.Sc. Computer Science or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with relevant practical experience and strong technical skills are encouraged to apply.

**Key Skills**

**Backend Development \| Python \| Django \| Flask \| FastAPI \| Java \| Spring Boot \| Node.js \| REST API \| SQL \| MySQL \| PostgreSQL \| ERP \| CRM \| HRM \| Git \| AWS \| Azure \| Docker \| API Integration \| Database Management \| Cloud Deployment**

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: Lead I - Software Testing(Cypress)
description:
**Role description**  


We are looking for an experienced Cypress Automation Test Engineer with 6\+ years of overall testing experience and strong hands\-on expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions using Cypress.



The ideal candidate should have strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, experience in frontend and backend testing, REST API validation, database testing, and CI/CD integration. The candidate should also possess strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities and be comfortable working within an Agile/Scrum delivery environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Cypress.
* Develop scalable and reusable automation frameworks and test components.
* Perform frontend and backend functional testing, including manual testing when required.
* Perform REST API testing using Cypress and/or Postman.
* Validate backend data and application functionality using SQL queries.
* Analyze test execution results, identify defects, and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Debug automation failures and work closely with development teams to resolve application and test\-related issues.
* Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage automation code and test assets using Git/Bitbucket.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other QA team members to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Identify opportunities to improve test automation coverage, execution efficiency, and overall product quality.

**Mandatory Skills \& Experience**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cypress automation testing.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Good experience in frontend and backend manual testing.
* Experience with REST API testing using Cypress and/or Postman.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience performing database validations.
* Hands\-on experience with Git and/or Bitbucket for version control.
* Experience integrating and executing automated tests through at least one CI/CD platform such as:
	+ Jenkins
	+ Azure DevOps
	+ GitHub Actions
	+ GitLab CI/CD
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

Good to Have / Preferred Skills
* Experience with Playwright automation testing.
* Experience working on projects within the Retail domain.
* Experience developing or enhancing automation frameworks.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end testing involving UI, API, and database layers.


  

**Skills**  

Cypress, Bitbucket, Git, Postman

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.
